title: Pointer swaps and shared prose lint may start in q_max, ios-adblock and joyous, with no job added
why: Owner, 19:31 CST Nov 17, in runner 12's chat (relayed by runner 12 to triage 11, 19:32 CST): the hold 'workflow edits wait' (relayed 11:20 CST Nov 16) lifts for pointer swaps and shared prose lint in q_max, ios-adblock and joyous, as long as no job is added. Other rulings in the same message: the parked PRs ios-adblock 169, 168 and 163, banchi 1003 and 1084, mailaudit 319, 244, 241, 240, 239, 238 and 144, and q_max 1185 (page item 920) stay open for the owner's local sessions, so no page item for them; joyous 89 merges after a check finds no issue.
source: runner 12 message to triage 11, 19:32 CST Nov 17; owner words not read first-hand
note: No written home for the 'workflow edits wait' hold was found by grep in the roadmap checkout; asked runner 12 for the record that holds it so the lifted scope can be written there.
